title: SEGMENT-VECTOR-LOGCAP: growing logarithmic leaf allowance strengthens space at n³ time

claims.statement: For EVERY N>=2 and secret s,n=ceil(log2N), the SINGLE SEGMENT-VECTOR-LOGCAP algorithm of proof.md/nonpower_merge.md/qudit_decoder.md recovers the ENTIRE secret with unconditional success>=1-2^-8 on independent ideal coset copies. Actual leaf allowance is NOW Cleaf=ceil(u/2)+64,u=ceil(log2n),not a fixed constant. Actualbase=ceil(d0r)+Cleaf,dl=base+2,Dwidth=floor(sqrt(2Cleaf*m))-1,Hlin=base+m-1,H=Hlin-Dwidth,allcappedwidths/supports/windows/cycles/jumps and block/root dimensions are rechecked. Atmost128 actual support-reset cycles, finite coarseDirichlet/CRTjump batches, full2^rout finePGM vectors,Cf2^161dl2m/globalA caps and deterministic allbranchcosts are reproduced. ALLFOUR bounds hold JOINTLY on EVERYbranch, including failed/rejected/discarded/partial sources, wrong labels/prefixes, finite correctness/costs, actual lookup/table initialization, addresses, bit/gate/circuit synthesis/measurement/reset/source costs. Actual plateau storage isO(nlogn2^H), initializationO(n²logn2^H); the growinglog is counted. BecauseCleaf<=.5logn+66, treeworkn2.5exp(m+dl) givesn3exp(t sqrt n). Strict Dwidth>1.1nquarter sqrtlogn-2 and chargedplateau yield the literal new classical exponent. q=141421/100000,t=39999899241/28284200000 exact, indices unchanged. No practical speed/optimum/priority or hiddenn-dependentconstant is claimed. Total charged work isO(n³2^(t sqrt n)),exactindex1/2.
